scope: Initial seed0-v2 RoboTL VoxPoser runs and hash-matched existing stock-current references. These are illustrative integration comparisons, not a controlled method ranking.

shared.scene: Identical scene.mjb SHA-256 verified per pair; hashes in comparison.json

voxposer.actions: Cartesian hand position + quaternion + scalar closure. Closure maps to fixed per-joint targets (1.2 rad on selected flexion joints).
voxposer.observations: Privileged collision vertices; radial approximate surface normals; hand pose. Geometry reobserved between waypoints.
voxposer.prediction: Spatial path planning and bounded arm inverse kinematics. No MuJoCo grasp candidate rollouts.
voxposer.contact_use: Native outcome validator only; no contact-force channel supplied to generated planning code.
voxposer.constraints: Native executed-state checks determine acceptance; NativeEpisode.run feasibility screening is bypassed.
voxposer.stopping: Stop at accepted hold, object-specific time cap, code error, or completed generated program plus 5.1 s holding last control.
voxposer.stage_handling: Instantiate final-stage objective directly; omit intermediate tool-stage hold requirements.

guided_mpc.actions: 7 arm and 16 finger targets with geometry-conditioned grasp/regrasp proposals and sampled refinements.
guided_mpc.observations: Native state, fingertip geometry and contact/support measurements used in loss evaluation.
guided_mpc.constraints: Screen rollouts for physical limits and penetration, with recorded recovery fallbacks.
guided_mpc.stopping: Advance through task stages; finish on acceptance or termination at time cap/no feasible rollout.
guided_mpc.stage_handling: Apple one lift stage; screwdriver/hammer include intermediate lift hold then final orientation hold.

mustard_reference.controller: Fixed servo trajectory; not Guided MPC
mustard_reference.note: The saved settings carry unused MPC-style fields. Controller source confirms fixed trajectory execution.

unmatched: Termination rule and realized episode duration
RNG seed and some runtime package versions

sources.native_acceptance_source: Each reference artifacts.zip includes source.py; Hold, NativeEpisode._record, NativeEpisode.run, within_limits.
